stories.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guard says it destroyed a US radar in Bahrain
stories.summary: Iran's IRGC claimed it destroyed a U.S. early-warning radar in Bahrain, its first such claim in months, after a U.S. strike on a telecom tower in Sirik. Neither that claim nor a reported tanker mine blast in the Strait of Hormuz was independently verified.

stories.title: IAEA 'increasingly concerned' over Iran's Isfahan enrichment plant
stories.summary: The UN nuclear watchdog said it is increasingly concerned about an underground uranium-enrichment plant at Isfahan that Tehran has not let it inspect, as the Iran war continues. Iran's navy separately claimed it shot down a U.S. MQ-1 Predator drone over the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Trump says Gulf allies urged restraint on Iran, claims US could finish it in 'three days'
stories.summary: Trump said Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the UAE and other Gulf states asked him to hold back on escalating against Iran, and that the U.S. could destroy the country's remaining energy, bridges and manufacturing in 'three days.' He said Israel is among the nations Washington is protecting.

stories.title: Trump confronts dwindling options to end the Iran conflict
stories.summary: NPR reports Trump's options to end the Iran war are narrowing after his midterm losses and Israel's political shakeup, leaving Gulf countries in limbo between pressure and patience.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen for fast agentic workflows
stories.summary: Google rolled out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a faster, lower-cost model built for coding and AI-agent tasks, across AI Studio, the Gemini API and Search. It sits below the frontier Carbon and Argon models for rapid everyday agent work.

stories.title: Apple TV 4K with Siri AI launches today at $299
stories.summary: Apple's fourth-generation Apple TV 4K, featuring an A19 chip and hands-free Siri AI, is available starting today at $299. Early hands-ons praise the new AI assistant and audio features while questioning the premium price.

stories.title: Monken says Browns won't change struggling offensive line
stories.summary: Browns coach Todd Monken said he will not change his offensive line despite Cleveland allowing an NFL-worst 38 sacks and committing the most pre-snap penalties. He called the starters 'our best players' and ruled out lineup changes.

stories.title: Skull Session: Buckeyes at No. 20, Jeremiah Smith's resolve, and a hypothetical Wake Forest matchup
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors' daily column frames Saturday's Northwestern game as a must-win after Ohio State slid to No. 20 in the CFP rankings, and notes a proposed 24-team playoff would have the Buckeyes facing Wake Forest.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Northwestern preview: Buckeyes need to win out to reach CFP
stories.summary: Yahoo's preview notes Ohio State has lost back-to-back regular-season games for the first time since 2011 and must win its final three games plus the Big Ten title to make the playoff. Freshman Luke Fahey starts his third straight game at quarterback.

stories.title: Three keys for Ohio State against Northwestern: heart, discipline, running game
stories.summary: Lettermen Row says Ohio State needs heart, discipline and a re-established running game to snap its two-game skid against Northwestern, after the defense allowed 71 combined points to USC and Oregon.

stories.title: FIA sets Nov. 25 hearing for Audi's appeal over Tsunoda's Italian GP
stories.summary: The FIA's International Court of Appeal will hear Audi's challenge on Nov. 25 over Yuki Tsunoda's Italian GP grid incident, which could strip the Racing Bulls driver of his only championship point and promote Gabriel Bortoleto to 10th.

stories.title: Haas considers bringing back Hirakawa for Qatar and Abu Dhabi
stories.summary: Haas is reportedly weighing a return for Ryo Hirakawa in the season-ending Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds, with Rafael Camara contesting Las Vegas first. No final driver plan has been confirmed by the team.

stories.title: Antonelli names Austin as his track-limits 'turning point'
stories.summary: Champion Kimi Antonelli said the U.S. Grand Prix in Austin was the turning point for his track-limits struggles, still his biggest admitted weakness after exceeding limits 130 times this season.

stories.title: Schumacher: Hamilton 'simply not fast enough' compared to Leclerc
stories.summary: Ralf Schumacher said Lewis Hamilton's Ferrari tension stems from being slower than teammate Charles Leclerc rather than the team's equal-driver policy, questioning whether either is still title material.

stories.title: Tarkov console version will be announced in 2027, Buyanov confirms
stories.summary: Battlestate Games director Nikita Buyanov said the console version of Escape from Tarkov will be announced next year, though it 'won't be ready next year,' as the studio nears a publishing deal. A 2027 announcement is '100%' certain, he said.

stories.title: Crew beat D.C. United 3-0 to stay in MLS playoff hunt
stories.summary: The Columbus Crew won 3-0 over D.C. United on goals from Zawadzki and Zaroury, keeping their MLS playoff push alive.

stories.title: Former OSU professor sentenced to life in wife's murder
stories.summary: A former Ohio State professor received a life sentence for the murder of his wife, in a case prosecutors tied to an alleged sextortion scheme.

stories.title: World Kindness Day stretches into a five-day celebration in Columbus
stories.summary: The Columbus Foundation's Center for HumanKindness launched its annual five-day Celebrate Kindness campaign today, featuring free YMCA meals, swag giveaways and seven surprise grants to school-serving nonprofits.

stories.title: Gahanna-area residents sending Christmas trees to service members
stories.summary: Residents across the Columbus area, including Gahanna, are collecting and shipping Christmas trees to U.S. service members stationed overseas, continuing a local holiday tradition.
